components.name: Ribbon Tab Button
components.description: The one primary action per view: a length of ribbon cut to an arrow notch.
components.css: .ds-tab-btn { --notch: 0.7rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; background: var(--ribbon, #a3221b); color: #fbf6ee; font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.85rem calc(1.4rem + var(--notch)) 0.85rem 1.4rem; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - var(--notch)) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - var(--notch)) 100%, 0 100%); border: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), translate 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab-btn:hover { background: var(--ribbon-deep, #7d1712); translate: 2px 0; } .ds-tab-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ribbon, #a3221b); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-tab-btn:disabled { background: var(--thread, #8a8580); cursor: not-allowed; translate: none; }

components.css: .ds-field { font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; } .ds-field label { display: block; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--taupe, #675f55); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; font: inherit; font-size: 0.98rem; color: var(--ink, #2a2420); background: var(--paper, #f4ecdb); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a99c87); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem; caret-color: var(--ribbon, #a3221b); accent-color: var(--ribbon, #a3221b); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--taupe, #675f55); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ribbon, #a3221b); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-hint { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--taupe, #675f55); margin-top: 0.3rem; }

components.css: .ds-nav { background: var(--buff, #ece3cf); padding: 1rem; font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; } .ds-nav ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 0.9rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a99c87); display: grid; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: block; padding: 0.38rem 0 0.38rem 0.6rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a423b); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: calc(-0.9rem - 5px); top: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; background: var(--buff, #ece3cf); border: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #2a2420); } .ds-nav a:hover::before { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #a99c87); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ribbon, #a3221b); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #2a2420); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::before { border: 1.5px solid var(--ribbon, #a3221b); background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--ribbon, #a3221b) 0 2.5px, var(--buff, #ece3cf) 3px); }

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) 10rem; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1.15rem 0.25rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #2a2420); background: var(--buff, #ece3cf); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #a99c87); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #cbbfac); font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper, #f4ecdb) 70%, var(--buff, #ece3cf)); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-title { color: var(--ribbon-deep, #7d1712); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ribbon, #a3221b); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-row-num { font-family: "Libre Caslon Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--taupe, #675f55); } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-family: "Libre Caslon Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.2; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row-sub { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a423b); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 0.3rem; } .ds-row-meta { font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--taupe, #675f55); text-align: right; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a museum registrar's custody file for an experiment. Every page sits on a warm archival buff ground, is set in ledger serifs, and carries one ribbon-red line that marks what a run record proves. Wherever the record is silent, the line stays as unwoven gray dashes. The visual system exists to keep proven, stopped, unobserved and not-applicable visibly distinct, so a skeptical reader never confuses "not run" with "safe".

Density is that of a reading room: a sticky left rail with the wordmark, a station-dot nav and a hairline case-ledger box, then a single reading column (42rem measure inside a 62rem page). Structure comes from hairline taupe rules and faint paper boxes, never from shadow or saturated fills. Titles, labels and links speak in ink; red is held back for evidence. Motion is minimal and evidential: the gray thread is present at rest and each carried segment draws over it in red, one after another.

The world refuses the standard ML project page: no centered hero, no pill buttons, no teaser figure. The one confirmed brand commitment is "polished but restrained, like a research project rather than a startup landing page."
keyCharacteristics: Warm archival buff ground with paper-toned boxes and hairline taupe rules.
Ribbon red is reserved for evidence and the one action: the custody line, carried marks, bookmark marks, injection tint and the ribbon-tab button.
Titles, section labels, the wordmark, nav and links are ink; links carry a ribbon-tinted underline.
Gray dashed "thread" means unknown or not run, everywhere.
Caslon Display titles, Caslon Text reading column, tracked small caps for labels, mono only for records and source.
Ribbon-bookmark marks and notched ribbon buttons as the recurring silhouette.
Every state mark is a shape plus a text label, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Evidence Red Rule
rules.body: Ribbon red marks evidence and the one primary action: a proven custody step, a carried mark, a bookmark, an injection's tint, the ribbon tab. Titles, labels, navigation and links are ink. It is never used for an unknown, not-run or not-applicable state; those are always thread gray and dashed.

rules.name: The Stamp Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Stamp ink appears only on sample data. Any surface carrying it is illustrative and must say so in words.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Attacker text is marked with the ruby tint behind ledger ink, never with red text on a red fill.

rules.name: The Figures Follow Function Rule
rules.body: Prose uses old-style figures. Tables, codes, row numbers and labels switch to lining figures (tabular in data).

rules.name: The Evidence-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only where text is a literal record: commands, model ids, final answers, HTML source. Never use it for decoration or headings.

rules.name: The Fixed Step Rule
rules.body: A new surface picks an existing step from the hierarchy above for its role. Do not add an in-between size; the three small-caps steps (0.74, 0.68, 0.66rem) are already the densest the ramp goes outside the stamp.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Lift Rule
rules.body: A surface is raised by a lighter paper tone and a hairline, never by a cast shadow. Hover changes tone, not elevation.

dos: Do draw every unknown, not-run or not-applicable state as a dashed thread-gray mark, and every proven step as solid ribbon red.
Do pair every state mark with a text label; shape and words carry the meaning, colour only reinforces it.
Do open each section with the ribbon bookmark and an ink small-caps section label.
Do set titles, labels, navigation and links in ink; links take the ribbon-tinted underline.
Do keep prose to the 42rem measure, left-aligned, on the buff ground.
Do mark attacker-written text with the ruby tint behind ledger ink, with a footer naming its placement.
Do stamp every sample record with stamp ink and say "not a model run" in words.
Do keep motion to the carried-segment draw (900ms ease-out, 260ms stagger) and 160-180ms tone changes, all disabled under reduced motion.
Do use the two radius steps only: 3px for small surfaces, 5px for large containers.
donts: Don't use ribbon red for an unknown or empty state; "not observed" must never look like "proven".
Don't set titles, section labels, nav items or link text in ribbon red; red is for evidence and the one action.
Don't use stamp ink anywhere except sample data.
Don't add outer drop shadows, glows or lifted cards; depth is paper tone and hairline.
Don't use pill buttons, centered hero titles or teaser-figure layouts.
Don't set headings or decoration in mono; mono is for literal records.
Don't add icon glyphs; marks are the drawn SVG bookmark, arrow, flag and state dots.
